stem:
Tyler read 10 books. The number of books Eli read can be represented by this expression.

4 \times 10

Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: Tyler read 10 times the number of books Eli read.

options.label: B
options.text: Eli read 10 times the number of books Tyler read.

options.label: C
options.text: Tyler read 4 times the number of books Eli read.

options.label: D
options.text: Eli read 4 times the number of books Tyler read.

difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of multiplication expressions and comparing quantities with variables representing unknowns.
